ci.yml.content:
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
  gitleaks:
    name: Gitleaks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo scan

auto-revert.yml.content:
name: Auto revert
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  auto-revert:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - run: echo revert
